essence: The ritual seat may be made using likuca, mango, kutaja, and katphala woods.
Jambu, madhuka, and vaikankata complete the named set of suitable woods.
After making the lion-seat, one should consecrate it immediately.
After dismissing the artisan and completing puṇyāha and sprinkling, the next rite proceeds.
At this stage the seat should not be washed with water of eight clays nor with kusha water.
